test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/86597ffc14e8d5cac810c8596540133d8e4f33ebfaf9f6da3eb78b7c252c8894.png]
solution:
The pattern followed in the given series is:

 **The characters forming a triangle shifts in clockwise direction(highlighted by arrow).

 A new character is introduced in every step at the top**(highlighted by square).

1)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c8b305bd60716a51ac9eeabc4e767fbb14cac7c45e263cd0c3a5c4929c3b2483.png] 

2)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f7750836ba579ea73715e66800e54af4db473a85641651f4ee9a8d973245697d.png] 

3)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ea7fefd55a61e0c4e85162c0ecbf2275f6bd34bc64d8eebb23624a5747ec8343.png] 

4)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ee10cf5edfeb06333c9367976d69134463db94590c5d334a4e1fcad70e880b00.png] 

Hence **the correct answer is option 3)**
